Lol, you’re so wrong right now. I’ve been rooting for masval since the old Betera days, and when tenzy joined them, I was really hoping some decent org would eventually pick those 2 guys up. And damn, they actually got lucky.
So when magic become a new team I really liked how AW and sFade8 looked in that roster, but h1te always worried me because of his questionable reputation. I was hoping they’d sign ICY, but mo0n ended up fitting the team surprisingly well.

So yeah, at least check the profile before accusing someone of being a “glory hunter.” I’ve been supporting this tag since it was created, and I’ve been following some of these players for almost two years already.
